astranl.use_when: you need Dutch construction cost, bankruptcy or labour-market figures

description: CBS construction economy: build cost input price index, construction bankruptcies, construction vacancy rate (latest stored period, CBS status Voorlopig/Definitief per row, freshness) plus CBS indicators (dwelling permits, establishments, labour). Provisional figures are revised by CBS. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
name: construction_economy
